commands.name: check-deploy-status
commands.title: Forge Deployments
commands.description: Shows sites that are currently being deployed

ai.instructions:
Deployments belong to sites, not servers.
Failed deploy: deployment-status names the site, then deployment-log. If nothing is marked failed, take the id from deployment-history.
Site down or erroring: site-online, then site-config for nginx-error-log, then application-log.
Server trouble, like provisioning or a service that will not start: server-events.
One site's common fields: get-site. One server's common fields and its sites: get-server. To find or list sites: list-sites.
Only deploy, restart or reboot when asked. Quick deploy off means Forge will not deploy on push by itself.
Look a site or server up first and pass the id it returns, as a string: "2882133", never 2882133. Given a partial name, search for it with list-sites rather than asking the user which site they mean.
Hand over any Forge link a tool returns as a markdown link, like [Deploy script](url), and never open or read the page yourself: it needs the user's own sign-in.

evals.input: @laravel-forge does acme-store have zero downtime deploys?

list-sites.note: Each row is a summary, not the whole record. For any other field, probe-api the site.

get-site.deploymentScript: Not returned. Read or edit it at https://forge.laravel.com/acme-org/web-1/5001/settings/deployments
get-site.deploymentUrl: Not returned. Find or rotate it at https://forge.laravel.com/acme-org/web-1/5001/settings/deployments

probe-api.name: acme-store.com

fields.status: Where the site is in its install, like installed or installing.
fields.php_version: The PHP version the site runs, like php83.
fields.zero_downtime_deployments: Whether deploys swap in an atomic release.
fields.deployment_script: The commands Forge runs on each deploy. Not handed over; the get tool returns a Forge link for it.
fields.environment: The site's env file, which Forge keeps on its own endpoint rather than on the site record. Not handed over; the get tool returns a Forge link for it.

probe-api.note: Name any of these in list-sites fields, or get-site include. Spelling of the name does not matter. These are names, not values.

tools.name: list-servers
tools.title: List Servers
tools.description: List your Forge servers. Rows are a summary; add fields for more.

tools.name: list-sites
tools.title: List Sites
tools.description: Search your Forge sites by part of a name, or list them all, or list one server's. Rows are a summary; add fields for more.

tools.name: get-site
tools.title: Get a Site
tools.description: One site's common fields, its latest deployment, and Forge links for what is not returned.

tools.name: get-server
tools.title: Get a Server
tools.description: One server's common fields and the sites on it. Pass include for a field it holds back.

tools.name: deployment-status
tools.title: Check Deployment Status
tools.description: Which sites are deploying now and which have a failed deploy.

tools.name: deployment-history
tools.title: Get Deployment History
tools.description: Recent deployments of a site, with status, commit and timings.

tools.name: deployment-log
tools.title: Read Deployment Log
tools.description: Output of a site's latest deploy, or of one deploy by id.

tools.name: server-events
tools.title: Get Server Events
tools.description: Recent events on a server, or the output of one event.

tools.name: site-online
tools.title: Check If a Site Is Online
tools.description: Whether a site answers over HTTP.

tools.name: site-config
tools.title: Read Site Config or Logs
tools.description: Read a site's nginx config, application log, nginx error log or access log.

tools.name: deploy-site
tools.title: Deploy a Site
tools.description: Deploy a site's latest commit. Pass the id from list-sites.

tools.name: restart-service
tools.title: Restart a Service
tools.description: Restart, reload or stop php, nginx, the database or redis on a server. Pass the id from list-servers.

tools.name: reboot-server
tools.title: Reboot a Server
tools.description: Reboot a server. Every site on it goes down until it returns. Pass the id from list-servers.

tools.name: probe-api
tools.title: Probe the Forge API
tools.description: Name every field Forge holds for one site or server, so you can ask the list and get tools for the ones you need.
